note: Performance & Rewards → Points. A Points Rule row says what an EVENT is worth (negative deducts); this file says where each event's COUNT comes from when the rules are auto-applied for a month. The rule amounts are never in code: an event with no rule row awards nothing. `Auto:` entries carry the month as `source_ref` so a month is never applied twice.

Perfect attendance.applied_as: points once, if the month had no late day and no absent day

Award received.applied_as: points × awards dated in the month

Test passed.applied_as: points × tests passed in the month

Target achieved.applied_as: entered by hand on the ledger

On-time streak.applied_as: points once, if at least `streak_days` present days in the month with no late mark

leaderboard.note: Rank is by net points; ties share a rank (1, 1, 3).
